text: Visitors have noted issues with low lighting in exhibit areas and a lack of clear signage, which made navigating the library confusing and frustrating for some. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as excessive and detracting from the experience. There were also complaints about food quality and pricing, with one visitor specifically mentioning a grilled cheese sandwich. Some visitors found the timed entry system unclear, leading to long lines at certain times and confusion about when to arrive. Parking and crowding were mentioned but less frequently.
